content: --- # Perspective API [![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/LIqveQm1?style=flat&logo=modrinth&color=17B85A&cacheSeconds=3600&label=Modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/perspective-api) [![CurseForge Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1575322?style=flat&logo=curseforge&color=F1643%5E&cacheSeconds=3600&label=CurseForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/perspective-api) Perspective API 是一个面向 Minecraft 客户端模组的相机视角管理框架。它基于 JOML 库提供标准化接口，用于处理相机状态（位置、旋转、FOV），并与 Minecraft 底层实现解耦。 # [文档](https://leawind.github.io/en_us/Perspective-API/) | [文档](https://leawind.github.io/zh_cn/Perspective-API/) ## [示例模组](https://modrinth.com/mod/perspective-api-demo) ---
